title: 6.6 Can and Cannot
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Understand simple route possibility and prohibition statements with can and cannot.
grammar_function: Subject + can/cannot + base verb; cannot contrasts use the same subject and route with a visibly open versus blocked condition.
speaking_outcome: Say three can and three cannot route sentences.

cards.pedagogy_note: Exact negative contrast; negated action visibly impossible.
Negative is visibly true only for blocked route.
Base verb after can; invalid form text only.

cards.spanish_translation: Él no puede cruzar la calle.

cards.pedagogy_note: Uses only explicitly established chunks; no dependency on an unconfirmed to-destination pattern.
Cannot must be present for meaning.
